assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 updates its bundled Kafka Exporter (upstream danielqsj/kafka_exporter) to version 1.9.0, per the changelog entry.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The changelog states the new version (1.9.0) but not the previous version, which the value-changed type requires (before and after, different); no before value is stated anywhere in the evidence.; applicability: The changelog entry names the Kafka Exporter version bump but not the image repository path the operator's deployments or chart values reference, so no exposure condition (e.g. image-in-use or a values key) can be asserted without inventing a name.; consequence: The changelog excerpt states only the version bump; it describes no operational effect, behavioral difference or required action for an exposed environment.
